piece: A designer's 11 s self-intro (the user's reference)
why: The house bar for moves: one circle carried letter, dot, pupil, eye, page, full frame, a new idea about every 1.2 s, a named constant at every boundary, one personality beat (the slit) and a last frame that is the next page. A textual frame-level breakdown only: no frames, no video, no third-party pixels. For the bar, never the content: never reuse an eye, a pupil, a slit, a thrown carrier, or a circle that becomes an eye. Timings are estimates from the clip's own clock (the 2.6 to 5.4 s core is where the ideas are densest).

ledger.carrier_state: the letters of 'Tiago' on a plain ground
ledger.change: the word deletes letter by letter back to 'a', and the 'a' morphs into an 'o' in the same 0.3 s
ledger.constant: baseline and horizontal centre: the surviving letter does not move while the others leave and its bowl becomes the whole letter
ledger.bridge: the 'a' and the 'o' share one bowl; for one frame the glyph is both

ledger.change: 'Y' flies in from the left and 'u' from the right to make 'Your' around it
ledger.constant: the 'o' is fixed at its position, centre-left, while both letters arrive
ledger.bridge: the 'o' stays put, so 'Your' is built around the carrier and the carrier is never re-placed
the filled disc has the exact outline of the letter's outer edge: one frame is both an 'o' and a disc

ledger.change: a black pupil grows from its centre until the disc reads as an eye
ledger.bridge: the pupil's edge is tangent to the rim for one frame: 'Your' and an eye are one object

ledger.carrier_state: a small orange eye in the word 'Your'
ledger.change: 'Y' and 'u' scatter away (pushed out by the throw); the eye is thrown up and to the right with motion blur after a short wind-up down
ledger.constant: the velocity vector, up and right
ledger.bridge: the throw's last-frame vector is the giant eye's first-frame vector

ledger.carrier_state: the small eye in flight, pupil leading
ledger.change: a dark panel rises with a white almond eye filling the frame; its pupil lands exactly where the small pupil was heading, the silhouette's head still visible above: one space
ledger.constant: the landing point of the pupil, and the one space around the silhouette
ledger.bridge: both pupils are true in one frame, the small pupil touching the giant pupil's rim as the giant eye rises

ledger.change: the round pupil narrows to a cat slit; the highlight slides across it; a push-in with blur
ledger.constant: pupil centre: only its shape changes, it does not move
ledger.bridge: none needed: the pupil stays at one point and only its shape changes (a personality beat that costs about 0.4 s)

ledger.change: the iris drifts; an orange ghost circle echoes the first disc; 'Creative' slides out from behind the slit, masked by the iris
ledger.constant: the slit as the door; the iris edge as the mask
ledger.bridge: the word is cut by the iris edge: the opening that was the pupil is the reveal

ledger.change: the eye-white scales past the frame and becomes the next scene's light background; 'Creative' now sits in dark type on it
ledger.constant: white fills the frame, 'Creative' stays where it was
ledger.bridge: the white is the next scene's ground: the last frame of the carrier is the first frame of the page

cards.title: The name deletes to one circle
cards.origin: the letters of 'Tiago' set at display size, one line inside the safe area
cards.frame_a: the word 'Tiago' in dark type on one line inside the safe area, baseline at y 540
cards.plain: The name erases down to one letter, which turns into a round o.
cards.move: 0.0 to 0.2 the letters delete from the ends inward, last to leave first; 0.2 to 0.3 the surviving 'a' morphs to an 'o' by closing its stem into the bowl; hold the 'o' fixed at centre-left
cards.frame_b: a single 'o' at centre-left, baseline unchanged
cards.bridge: the frame where the 'a' stem is half closed: the glyph is both 'a' and 'o' on the same bowl at the same position
cards.handoff: the 'o' at centre-left, its centre at (400, 540), ink colour, which 'Y' and 'u' arrive around
cards.says: the carrier is chosen before the word exists: the name is reduced to the one shape the film will carry
cards.setup: none needed: deletion reads in one beat
cards.precedent: Ferro-style kinetic type; differs: the deletion's survivor is the carrier of the next ten seconds

build.layers: glyph paths for a and o with matching point counts
build.risk: the morph shows blobs in the middle
build.simplest: cross-fade a and o at the held bowl position over 3 frames

cards.title: The o fills and grows a pupil, thrown
cards.frame_a: the word 'Your' with the 'o' as the only fixed letter, 'Y' and 'u' just arrived
cards.plain: The o fills orange, grows a pupil and is thrown off the word.
cards.move: 0.0 to 0.2 the 'o' fills solid orange; 0.2 to 0.4 a black pupil grows from its centre; 0.4 to 0.5 'Y' and 'u' scatter outward, pushed by the eye's wind-up down 0.1 s; 0.5 to 0.6 the eye is thrown up and right with motion blur
cards.frame_b: a small orange eye in flight, pupil leading, about 25 percent of the frame width
cards.bridge: the frame where the pupil's edge is tangent to the rim: 'Your' and an eye are one object at one position
cards.handoff: the pupil's centre at (1180, 300), the vector up and right at about 2 200 px/s, the orange
cards.says: the film is about seeing: the designer's point of view is stated by a letter, not by a line
cards.setup: the 'o' has already stayed still while 'Your' was built around it, so the viewer is watching it
cards.precedent: Vertigo's pupil radiating spirals; differs: a letter becomes the eye and is thrown with a cause

build.layers: o as SVG circle, pupil circle, blur copy, Y and u spans
build.risk: the blur copy reads as a double
build.simplest: scale the o, swap to the eye art on the throw frame, keep the pupil anchor

cards.title: The giant pupil lands, slits, lets a word out
cards.origin: the thrown eye's pupil and the next word 'Creative'
cards.frame_a: the small eye in flight, up and right, pupil leading, over the dark panel starting to rise
cards.plain: A giant eye rises, its pupil lands where the small one was going, narrows, and a word slides out.
cards.move: 0.0 to 0.1 a dark panel rises with a white almond eye; the giant pupil lands exactly where the small one was heading; 0.1 to 0.5 the round pupil narrows to a cat slit, the highlight slides, push-in with blur; 0.5 to 1.1 the iris drifts, an orange ghost circle echoes the first disc, and 'Creative' slides out from behind the slit, masked by the iris edge
cards.frame_b: the giant eye filling the frame, slit pupil at the landing point, 'Creative' half out of the slit, dark type on white
cards.bridge: the frame where the small pupil touches the giant pupil's rim as the panel rises: both eyes are one eye, the silhouette's head still visible above, one space
cards.handoff: the slit's centre and the iris edge as the mask; the word 'Creative' at its rest position
cards.says: personality (the slit costs about 0.4 s) and function (the slit is the door that reveals the word)
cards.setup: the thrown small eye established the pupil's heading; the giant pupil answers it
cards.precedent: match on action plus graphic match; differs: the landing point is the constant, the slit is the door

build.layers: panel, eye-white path, pupil path with two states, iris mask, word span
build.risk: the landing misses by a few pixels and the one-space illusion breaks
build.simplest: hold the pupil position fixed in both and scale the panel around it

cards.title: The eye-white becomes the next page
cards.origin: the eye-white of the giant eye
cards.frame_a: the giant eye with 'Creative' out of the slit, the white of the eye filling most of the frame
cards.plain: The white of the eye grows past the frame and is the next page.
cards.move: 0.0 to 0.4 the eye-white scales from its rim outward about the pupil, past all four edges; 0.4 the frame is white; the next scene's light background is the same white and 'Creative' is already set in dark type on it
cards.frame_b: a full white frame with 'Creative' in dark type, the next page
cards.bridge: the frame where the eye-white's rim has just left the last edge: the carrier and the next scene's ground are the same white
cards.handoff: the white ground, 'Creative' at its rest position, the carrier handed to the next page as its container
cards.says: the eye was never decoration: it was the page
cards.setup: the first eye-white fill (the 'o' as a disc) taught that the shape fills
cards.precedent: scale-through (2001 bone to satellite family); differs: the ground itself is the carrier

build.layers: eye-white path scaled about the pupil centre
build.simplest: fade the panel to the white ground on the frame the rim leaves the corners

chain.change: 'Tiago' deletes letter by letter back to 'a'
'Y' and 'u' fly in around the fixed 'o' to make 'Your'
a black pupil grows inside the disc: the o is an eye
'Y' and 'u' scatter and the small eye is thrown up and right with motion blur
a dark panel rises with a giant almond eye; its pupil lands where the small one was heading
the round pupil narrows to a cat slit, highlight slides, push-in with blur
the iris drifts, an orange ghost circle echoes, 'Creative' slides out from behind the slit
the eye-white scales past the frame and becomes the next page, 'Creative' in dark type on it

lessons: the transition is the stage; the words stay readable
a new idea about every 1.2 s
every boundary has a named constant
the last frame becomes the next page
